name: empty-state
title: Empty state
purpose: What a view shows when it has no data yet, with the way to get some.
whenToUse: In place of a list, table or panel that has nothing in it yet.
When a search or filter matches nothing. Say so, and offer to clear it.
With the compact size, for an empty section inside a list or a panel.
whenNotToUse: While the data is still loading. Use a spinner.
When loading failed. Use an error state, so the reader is not told there is nothing when there may be.
To welcome or to promote a feature. An empty state says what is missing and nothing more.

sizes.name: default
sizes.use: For a whole view. A 16px title, and room above and below.

sizes.name: compact
sizes.use: For a section inside a list or a panel. The title is the size of a row's text and the action is a small button.

accessibility: The title is a heading at the level that fits the view's outline, usually h2, or h3 for the compact size inside a section.
The body is one sentence saying what will appear here and how to get it.
At most one action, inside gw-empty-state__action. It is the primary button only when it is the view's main action. Use a link element when it goes to another view.
It is left-aligned and sits where the data will be. Do not centre it.
When the empty state replaces content after a search or filter, announce the result count in a separate role="status" element, such as 0 runs. The empty state itself takes no role.
